data.narrative: Devanshi demonstrated elite incident command capabilities under real-world pressure. Successfully triaged an active SEV1 authentication bypass on the admin deletion endpoint, maintained transparent and structured stakeholder communication across multiple high-stakes interruptions without yielding to pressure to minimize breach reality, deployed verified defense-in-depth authorization middleware, and executed point-in-time recovery (PITR) to restore 12 deleted records without data loss.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained an empathetic, authoritative, and honest communication cadence with the VP of Product, refusing to downplay the breach while providing concrete operational reassurance for the upcoming prospect demo.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recorded stakeholder communications across Phase 2, 4, and 6 in progress/debugging/module-05-incident-log.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Quickly hypothesized that empty string authorization headers bypassed falsy checks or produced undefined tokens that were mishandled in token validation.
Interpreted WAF log telemetry and database audit timestamps, identifying 12 soft-deleted records across 8 tenant accounts originating from the malicious external IP.
Engineered a 5-point boundary verification harness covering missing, empty, whitespace, malformed, and valid Bearer headers.
dimension_scores.evidence: All 5 test cases passed in scripts/drill-auth-bypass-incident.ts.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that header existence checks are fundamentally insufficient for security boundaries and enforced explicit format validation, non-empty token parsing, and cryptographic verification.
Developed a comprehensive recovery and prevention plan including PITR WAL restoration, WAF IP rate limiting, multi-person confirmation for admin deletions, and proactive customer notifications.

strengths: Incorruptible engineering integrity when pressured by executive leadership to downplay security breaches
Decisive severity classification preventing blast-radius escalation
Comprehensive point-in-time restoration without permanent customer data loss
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 06 to tackle multi-layer system bugs spanning microservice and architectural boundaries.

public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows high-maturity engineering leadership, blameless communication, operational poise, and database disaster recovery capabilities.
